frank: did the nightly docs scan on staging ~22:45; found 8 broken internal refs, 1 shortlink to an archived page, and a YAML frontmatter duplicate in runbooks/ops.md. small PRs. who can pick?

adele: i can take the shortlink and the archived redirect. share the exact path?

frank: shortlink: /s/old-runbook -> should go to /runbooks/ops.md. frontmatter error pasted below:

```
docs-lint | ERROR: YAML parse failed: duplicate key "maintainer" at runbooks/ops.md:4
```

vik: i'll grab the frontmatter cleanup and run prettier on the file. sed to remove the dup should be fine.

doc-bot: scan-report: /var/reports/docscan/6801239876.json (8 broken refs, 1 archived shortlink, 1 frontmatter error)

miguel: quick tip for anchors: `rg "^#+ .*" docs/ --line-number | sed -n '1,200p'` then `rg "#your-anchor" -n` to locate refs fast. also `npx linkinator` for bulk checks.

adele: opened PR https://github.internal/redwood/pull/4012 replacing /s/old-runbook with canonical path and adding a redirect entry.

vik: PR https://github.internal/redwood/pull/4013 removes duplicate "maintainer" key and fixes a tiny mdx lint warning; previewed locally with `yarn docs:preview`.

doc-bot: ci: queued docs-lint for PRs 4012,4013; running link-check, mdx-lint, frontmatter-parser.

miguel: added adele and vik to the docs-owners sheet (tab: Runbooks) so ownership is clear.

frank: plan: merge after green CI, deploy during low traffic 02:00 UTC. if link-check still flags things we'll do a rapid manual sweep and tag leftovers as backlog.

adele: pinging reviewers for quick LGTM on 4012. small change.

vik: will watch CI and merge during the window if green.

frank: thanks all, i'll post a one-liner in #eng-status after deploy. if anything blocks i'll @eng-oncall and open an incident stub.
